Remark
[transnormal functions]

Source: petersen:page-0150 ↗ thm:pet-ch4-brinkmann-warped-product 1. ch4:4.3.5A function $f:M\to \mathbb {R}$ is transnormal if $|df|^2=\rho ^2(f)$ for some smooth $\rho $; functions with conformal Hessian are locally transnormal by subsection 3.2, but the converse fails: on the doubly warped representation $dr^2+\sin ^2(r)d\theta _1^2+\cos ^2(r)d\theta _2^2$ of $S^3(1)$ on $(0,\pi /2)\times S^1\times S^1$, $f=\tfrac 14\sin (2r)$ is transnormal but does not have conformal Hessian.
